item.description:
What's New in VoiceInk 2.20

  • 🧠 Introduced the Dictionary Auto Learn feature
  • 📦 Support for importing and exporting dictionaries
  • 🕘 Faster access to recent transcriptions with Quick History
  • 🖱️ Added support for mouse shortcuts
  • 🗣️ Added support for Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0
  • 🤖 Added support for Gemini 3.8 Flash and Qwen 3.8 27B enhancement models
  • 🌍 Support for French localization
  • ⚡ Improved OpenRouter performance and stability
  • 🛠️ Minor bug fixes and improvements
